adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `poll_feed` parses an admin-configured `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url` and calls `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, ...)` for each `rss.items` entry, with only URL-shape handling (`url !~ /^https?\:\/\//` then fallback to `i.id`, and `TopicEmbed.import` itself only rejects non-`http(s)` via `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`). There is no `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` check on the item URL host, unlike the embed path (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`). This is a real, diff-grounded asymmetry and could be intentional given the admin-controlled feed, but the diff provides no comment/test asserting that cross-host item imports are allowed, so the review concern is actionable but not a provable defect from the diff alone.
